inputs.inputs:script:
ENABLED = True               # False = pass the command through unchanged (ideal sim)
GAIN_CMD = 0.86              # gain used in ackermann_to_vesc (servo units per rad)
MAX_STEERING_ANGLE = 0.25    # rad, clipping in ackermann_to_vesc
GAIN_LEFT = 0.728            # characteristic from servo calibration (servo units per rad)
GAIN_RIGHT = 0.755
BACKLASH_LEFT = 0.026        # backlash towards the left  [servo units]
BACKLASH_RIGHT = 0.023       # backlash towards the right [servo units]
REST_POSITION = -0.0045      # rest position of the wheel within the play [servo units]
                             # (~ -0.006 rad when driving straight, as measured)
WHEEL_BASE = 0.26            # m, same value as in the Ackermann Controller node
TRACK_WIDTH = 0.17           # m, same value as in the Ackermann Controller node (check!)

import math


def setup(db):
    print(f"[steering model] enabled={ENABLED} gain_cmd={GAIN_CMD} max={MAX_STEERING_ANGLE} "
          f"gL={GAIN_LEFT} gR={GAIN_RIGHT} bL={BACKLASH_LEFT} bR={BACKLASH_RIGHT} rest={REST_POSITION}")


def cleanup(db):
    pass


def compute(db):
    cmd = db.inputs.steeringAngleIn
    if not ENABLED:
        db.outputs.steeringAngleOut = cmd
        db.outputs.wheelAnglesOut = ackermann_wheel_angles(cmd)
        return True
    if not math.isfinite(cmd):
        cmd = 0.0
    # 1. Clip and convert to servo travel (same as ackermann_to_vesc)
    d = min(max(cmd, -MAX_STEERING_ANGLE), MAX_STEERING_ANGLE)
    u = GAIN_CMD * d
    # 2. Backlash: within the play, the tire's self-aligning torque pulls the wheel
    #    towards its rest position, so it sits at the point of the play range
    #    [u - BACKLASH_LEFT, u + BACKLASH_RIGHT] closest to REST_POSITION
    w = min(max(REST_POSITION, u - BACKLASH_LEFT), u + BACKLASH_RIGHT)
    # 3. Convert back to the wheel angle (characteristic per side)
    delta = w / (GAIN_LEFT if w >= 0.0 else GAIN_RIGHT)
    db.outputs.steeringAngleOut = delta
    db.outputs.wheelAnglesOut = ackermann_wheel_angles(delta)
    return True


def ackermann_wheel_angles(delta):
    """Left and right wheel angle [rad] for the steering angle delta of the virtual centre wheel.

    The turning centre lies on the rear axle at the signed radius R = WHEEL_BASE / tan(delta)
    (+ = left). The inner wheel is closer to it and turns more than the outer wheel.
    """
    if abs(delta) < 1e-9:
        return [0.0, 0.0]
    R = WHEEL_BASE / math.tan(delta)
    left = math.atan(WHEEL_BASE / (R - TRACK_WIDTH / 2))
    right = math.atan(WHEEL_BASE / (R + TRACK_WIDTH / 2))
    return [left, right]
